It was useful for lighting control without needing an external sensor. It also allowed custom delay/advance settings, like switching 30 minutes before sunset.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members are actively sharing feature requests and ideas for both [product_name] hardware and software, highlighting strong engagement. Major topics include advanced clock features, such as radio-controlled and astronomical time functions, and better usability of navigation controls. Users also point out inconsistencies between software simulation and real hardware navigation, especially regarding the reliability of arrow keys.
analysis.user_expectations: Forum users expect future [product_name] hardware and software updates to deliver new user-friendly features such as improved real-time clock options and more intuitive navigation controls. They are looking for better functionality and consistency between the software simulation and the actual hardware interface.
